description: This file contains an internal abstract class 'Striped64' used for thread-safe, lock-free atomic operations with a lazily-initialized striped table of variables. It manages contention through a combination of base values and per-thread cells, implementing a mechanism similar to Java's LongAdder or Striped64 pattern for high concurrency counters.

classes.name: Striped64
classes.description: An abstract class providing a concurrent scalable structure for maintaining thread-local atomic counters with striped cells, including logic for contention management and dynamic resizing.

classes.name: Striped64.Cell
classes.description: A nested class representing a padded atomic long value to reduce cache contention.

methods.name: CasCellsBusy
methods.description: Performs an atomic compare-and-swap to acquire the lock for resizing or initializing the cell array.

methods.name: VolatileWriteNotBusy
methods.description: Resets the _cellsBusy lock indicator to 0, releasing the lock.

methods.name: GetProbe
methods.description: Retrieves the current thread's hash code used for indexing into the cell array.

methods.name: AdvanceProbe
methods.description: Advances the thread's probe value using xorshift operations for rehashing during contention.

methods.name: LongAccumulate
methods.description: Handles updates to the counter with contention management, initializing and resizing the cell array as needed, or updating the base value on low contention.
